book.title: The Limits to Growth
book.author: Donella H. Meadows, Dennis L. Meadows, Jørgen Randers and William W. Behrens III

predict.question: Your stockroom starts with 50 units. Each step you restock 2 and receive a request for 7. After ten updates, how many units are left?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Finite resource stocks constrain indefinitely maintained material throughput.
modelBoundary: Partial replacement leaves {A}; full replacement leaves {B}. The first path loses five units per step until it reaches the nonnegative floor.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This is stock accounting, not World3. It predicts no discoveries, substitution, prices or collapse date.
